resume_steps: 1. Respawn repair-agent-session-types FIRST: agent_session.rs has 65 of the 87 errors. Instruct it to WRITE declarations first, in small appends, and leave a // REPAIR CURSOR comment.
2. Respawn a worker for daemon_worker_client.rs + daemon_mode.rs (8 + 6 errors).
3. Then the long tail (~8 errors across 8 files).

5. Write HANDOFF.md, refresh docs/MIGRATION-MAP.md, run the parity harness.
6. Push ONLY branch rust-port/current-windows-20260911 and report the URL.
hazards_to_remember: NEVER run git stash/reset/checkout while workers are live (self-inflicted incident, evidence/incidents.md).
Exactly one live writer per file; see evidence/repair-ownership.json.
grep -c 'error\[E' MISSES bare 'error:' syntax errors; trust the exit code.
Files mid-write show transient syntax errors; check mtime age before acting.
Crate-root mod.rs files are reached via lib.rs ([path="mod.rs"] pub mod index;) - not defects.
Do not add a DaemonCommand::new builder: the canonical API is DaemonCommandBody = Map<String,Value>.
Cap: total agents (all depths) <= 15; sub-agents must never spawn children.
